name: lying abdominal scissors crunch
description: Lying on your back, you crunch up while scissoring your legs. It works the upper and lower abs together.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and your legs slightly off the floor.
Scissor your legs up and down in alternating motion.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set count of reps.
